record.paper_title: Open problems on compact constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
record.original_question: Let C₁ and C₂ be two convex curves contained in parallel planes. If Σ is a compact embedded constant-mean-curvature surface spanning C₁ ∪ C₂, must Σ be a topological annulus?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.6. Let C₁ and C₂ be two convex curves in parallel planes. Is a compact embedded cmc surface spanning C₁∪C₂ a topological annulus?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $C_1$ and $C_2$ be two disjoint smooth convex Jordan curves contained in two distinct parallel planes in Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^3$. Let $\Sigma \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ be a compact embedded surface with constant mean curvature whose boundary $\partial\Sigma$ equals $C_1 \cup C_2$ (i.e., $\Sigma$ spans $C_1 \cup C_2$). Must $\Sigma$ be homeomorphic to an annulus (a topological cylinder)?
artifact.category_tag: Constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem about compact embedded CMC surfaces spanning two convex curves in parallel planes. Partial results exist: for the minimal case (H=0), Meeks–White and others proved that under suitable conditions the surface must be an embedded annulus, and existence results give CMC radial graphs as annuli when the planes are sufficiently close. The general CMC embedded case for arbitrary parallel convex boundaries does not appear to have a confirmed resolution in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: On minimal surfaces bounded by two convex curves in parallel planes
status_evidence.snippet: A compact minimal surface bounded by two closed convex curves in parallel planes close enough must be topologically an annulus.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results in the minimal (H=0) case under proximity assumptions.

status_evidence.title: Radial Graphs of Constant Mean Curvature and Doubly Connected Minimal Surfaces with Prescribed Boundary
status_evidence.snippet: There exist constant mean curvature surfaces spanning two given convex curves in parallel planes under hypotheses on distance and curvature; surface is a radial graph.
status_evidence.claim: Existence results for CMC annuli under restrictive geometric hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: Compact constant mean curvature surfaces in Euclidean three-space
status_evidence.snippet: Studies of compact CMC surfaces with boundary in Euclidean space.
status_evidence.claim: General CMC embedded annulus question not fully resolved.
